source: Covenant UMC Austin — Circuit worship planning

items.text:
Welcome pilgrims on the way to the cross.
We are learning to follow Jesus. 
The way is long, and we are thirsty.
We seek the living waters of Jesus. 
We feel the weight of scarcity warring with hopeful whispers of abundance.
We need the living waters of Jesus. 
We wonder if God will provide us with what we need, here and now.
As God gives us the living waters of Jesus, so God calls us to quench the thirst and meet the needs of our neighbors.
Pilgrims on the way, come let us worship God!
We come to worship God as we learn to live inside out! Amen.

Welcome pilgrims on the way to the cross.
**We are learning to follow Jesus.**
On this Lenten journey, where do we find God’s presence among us?
**One thing we know: God calls us to witness extraordinary love in ordinary moments.**
On this Lenten journey, how does God’s presence work among us?
**One thing we know: God uses the messy and mundane to heal and restore us to one another. **
On this Lenten journey, what does God’s presence do in our midst?
**One thing we know: God opens us to recognize presence, sustenance, and abundance where the world perceives isolation and lack. **
Pilgrims on the way, come let us worship God!
**We come to worship God as we learn to live inside out! Amen.**

Welcome pilgrims on the way to the cross.
**We are learning to follow Jesus.**
The journey is long, and the burden of our sins and struggles feels so heavy.
**Yet we will hope in God because with God, there is steadfast love.**
All around us, we witness neighbors and communities who are lifeless, despairing that they could ever be revived.
**Yet God tells us that to come back to life, we must come together.**
Year after year of change and struggle have taken their toll—how can anyone bring forth life when we feel so parched and tired?
**Yet God meets the lifeless with the breath of life, reviving us again to worship and follow God’s way.**
Pilgrims on the way, come let us worship God!
**We come to worship God as we learn to live inside out! Amen.**

Give thanks to God for God is good;
**God’s steadfast love endures forever! Hosanna!**

We give thanks to God who answers us, for God is our saving help!
**The stone the builders rejected is now the cornerstone! Hosanna!**

Our salvation is at hand!
**It is marvelous to behold! Hosanna!**

This is the day that the Lord has made!
**Let us rejoice and be glad! Hosanna!**

Blessed is the one who comes in the name of the Lord!
**Come save us, Lord! Hosanna!**

Give thanks to God for God is good;
**God’s steadfast love endures forever! Hosanna!**

The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
**And also with you.**

Taste and see the goodness of the Lord.
**Christ has prepared a feast of love.**

God is light, in whom there is no darkness at all.
**Jesus Christ is the light of the world.**

And this is the judgment, that the light has come into the world,
**and we loved darkness rather than light.**

The dark night is behind us; the morning light erased all darkness and doubt.
**All that remains is the empty tomb and the wrappings of pain and death.**

The Lord has risen; he’s no longer among the dead.
**He lives. The Lord has risen!**

Yes, the Lord lives! The new morning fills our hearts with joy and hope.
**Let us then worship together, extinguishing all doubt and fear with joyful songs and an unbreakable faith in our Redeemer.**

Christ is risen!
**Christ is risen, Allelujah!**

Come, People of God.
**Christ is risen, Allelujah!**

Come, Let us Rebuild the Walls.
**Christ is risen, Allelujah!**

Come, Let us step into God's future.
**Christ is risen, Allelujah!**

Christ is risen!
**Christ is risen, Alleluia!**

We come to walk with you.
**Christ is risen, Alleluia!**

Help us not to fall behind
**Christ is risen, Alleluia!**

Show us, again, who you are.
**Christ is risen, Alleluia!**

items.theme: Our God Will Fight For Us
items.text:
Christ is risen!
**Christ is risen, Alleluia!**

You are the gate and the gatekeeper.
**Christ is risen, Alleluia!**

You are the Alpha and Omega.
**Christ is risen, Alleluia!

You are the Good Shepherd.
**Christ is risen, Alleluia!**

Christ is risen.
**Christ is risen, Alleluia!**

In my Father's house, there are many dwelling places.
**Christ is risen, Alleluia!**

Let us dwell with the Lord this day!
**Christ is risen, alleluia!**

Christ is risen!
**Christ is risen, Alleluia!**

You sent the Holy Spirit to advocate for us.
**Christ is risen, Alleluia!**

You will not leave us orphaned.
**Christ is risen, Alleluia!**

Help us to keep your commandments.
**Christ is risen, Alleluia!**

Help us to love.
**Christ is risen, Alleluia!**

Come and worship, people of God!
**Let’s celebrate with songs of praise!**
For our God—the Most High—is seated on his holy throne, over all the earth!
**Let’s worship God together.**

Come, Holy Spirit,
**The fire of God, the breath of Life.**
Come, Holy Spirit,
**Our Advocate, our Counselor.**
Come, Holy Spirit,
**Teacher of Wisdom, Reminder of Christ.**
Come, Holy Spirit,
**Granter of forgiveness, giver of peace.**
Come, Holy Spirit.
**May we feel God's fire through our worship.**

Come all who are weary!
**Our God is near.**
Do not be afraid!
**Our God is near.**
Father, Son, and Holy Spirit. 
**Bring us to our rest in you.**

Come be with us, Lord.
**As we walk this journey together.**

Make our paths straight.
**So that we never stray from your Love.**

Seek us out,
**When we get in our own way.**

Call us home.
**We do not rest until we rest in you.**

This is the day that the Lord has made.
**Let us rejoice and be glad in it.**

Meet us when we least expect it.
*Make us laugh with surprise.**

Meet us when we call out to you.
**Have compassion over your children. 

Shape us to be your laborers.
**The harvest is plentiful but the laborers are few.**

The Lord listens to us in times of trouble and joy.
**We call to the Lord in our anxiety and fear.**
God will not turn away from us.
**God will heal us and restore us.**
Let the Lord of life enter into your spirits.
**Lord, come to us and heal our brokenness and sorrow. AMEN.**

We come for the water of life.
**Quench our thirst in your river.**

May we receive you.
**And the one who sent you.**

May we be received.
**May we share your mercy.**

items.theme: Come to me, all who are weary
items.text:
The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
**And also with you**
The risen Christ is with us.
**Praise the Lord**
